parsed.summary: The PR addresses a specific issue with fixture directories containing Path instances but introduces a non-minimal change by converting all fixture_dirs to strings.

issues.description: The change converts all fixture_dirs to strings, which may not be necessary and could introduce unexpected behavior if other parts of the code expect Path instances.
